hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty'); [ -n "$f" ] || exit 0; cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css) ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true;; *) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.jsx|*.mjs|*.cjs) out=$(./node_modules/.bin/eslint --fix --quiet "$f" 2>&1) || { printf '%s\n' "ESLint errors remain after --fix in $f:" "$out" >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
hooks.statusMessage: Formatting with Prettier and fixing with ESLint...
